name: Anakim The
overview: The Anakim were a formidable people of great stature and strength who inhabited the mountainous region of Judah, notably around Hebron. Despite the fear they inspired in Israel, Caleb's unwavering faithfulness to the LORD enabled him to drive them out and claim Hebron as his inheritance, a promise God confirmed through Moses. Even at an advanced age, Caleb remained strong for battle, exemplifying steadfast trust in God amidst daunting opposition.
